description: Buys one or more mobile, server or backconnect proxies and charges the account balance immediately. With estimate_only=true it returns the total without charging or allocating. country accepts an ISO code or id_country; geoid from get_geo_list pins an exact location. Returns the new proxies with full connection details.

count.description: How many proxies (max 50 in one call)

country.description: Target country as 2-letter ISO code (or use id_country / geoid)

estimate_only.description: Return the total amount without charging or allocating

period_days.description: Rental period in days; one of 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365

name: buy_proxy
title: Buy proxies
